title: D2 Start the trip: 'Cash handed to you' treats an emptied field as ₹0, not as 'use the planned float'
rootCause:
CONFIRMED by re-tracing. There is one cause, and it is in the screen. The kit pad and the backend both behave as designed.

1. frontend/delivery-app/app/trip/start.tsx:75 holds `cashPaise: number | null`, where null means 'not touched'. Line 290 renders `value={cashPaise ?? detail?.openingCashPaise ?? null}` and line 291 passes `onChange={setCashPaise}` unchanged. So null carries two meanings: 'not touched' and 'emptied by the driver'. Every render treats an emptied field as untouched and shows the planned float again. Line 347 (the confirm body) repeats the same fallback.

2. Native (Android and iOS). The money pad's Clear (frontend/libs/ui/src/native/money.tsx:290-297, which calls pressMoney('clear')) and ⌫ down to empty (:179-183) both call `onChange(paiseFromPadEntry(''))`, which is null (frontend/libs/ui/src/money.ts:132-135, 142-144).
   - The screen re-renders the pad with value 300000.
   - `reconcilePadEntry('', 300000)` (money.ts:162-164) lets the parent win. That is the DOS-060 rule, pinned at money.test.ts:173-195 with exactly this `amount ?? owed` case. It returns padEntryFromPaise(300000) = '3000' (money.ts:125-129).
   - The next digit appends: pressMoneyPadKey('3000','4') = '30004' (money.ts:152), so 4-7-5-6 reads ₹3,00,04,756.
   - ⌫ from an empty entry goes 3000 → 300 → 30 → 3 → back to 3000.
   - Evidence: QA/evidence/batch1/regression/android/delivery-060-30-cash-field-after-done-nodes.txt shows the field as '₹3,000.00' / '3000 rupees' after Done.

3. Web. This is the same screen with the web kit's RupeeInput text field, at every width.
   - Emptying the input calls onChange(null) (frontend/libs/ui/src/web/money.tsx:225-231), and the parent re-renders with value 300000.
   - On blur (:232-237), the empty text is replaced by toEditableRupees(value) = '3000.00'.
   - The `[value, focused]` effect (:152-154) writes the same text again once focus drops.
   - So on web too, a driver cannot record an empty float or ₹0.

4. No second cause was found:
   - Depart (start.tsx:124-133, 351-356) leaves `openingCashPaise` out when cashPaise is null.
   - The server keeps the plan with `input.openingCashPaise ?? trip.openingCashPaise` (backend/libs/core/src/modules/delivery/trips.service.ts:388). Because it uses `??`, a 0 is applied.
   - DepartTripInput.openingCashPaise is `PaiseSchema.nonnegative().optional()` (backend/libs/contracts/src/delivery.ts:735).
   - No trigger or check touches trips.opening_cash_paise; only migrations/0002 names the column.
   - Depart is online-only: trips is not a delivery-writable sync table (start.tsx:4-8).
   - 'delivery' is in TRIP_PLANNERS for startLoading and depart (backend/libs/contracts/src/permissions.ts:189-194, 661-662).
   - The float feeds expectedCashPaise = openingCashPaise + cash − expenses (delivery.mappers.ts:593; settlement.service.ts:222, 368), so a wrong float shows up as a false variance at check-in.
   - useQuery's isLoading is true only before the first data arrives (frontend/libs/api-client/src/react/index.tsx:286). The ['trip'] invalidation after startLoading (start.tsx:113) therefore neither unmounts the form nor touches cashPaise.

5. Data (read-only, dos_qa): sai-distributors TRIP-NEXT is planned, opening_cash_paise 300000, trip_date 2026-09-14, driver sachin.dalvi, 2 stops whose orders are packed. sachin.dalvi's location_consents row is granted, policy_version gps-notice-2026-09. This matches the finding.

The architect's design (QA/evidence/batch1/held-review-brief.md:362) is correct: an emptied field means ₹0, not 'use the float'. The finding's first suggestion (seed the value once in an effect) adds a seeding flag and a refetch race, and gains nothing over a render-time rule. Its second suggestion (a 'Use planned float' chip) is a UX addition the design does not ask for.

changes.what:
New pure module with no React, no kit and no imports, following the DOS-061 src/lib/trip-choice.ts pattern.

It exports two functions:
(a) `openingCashShown(entered: number | null, plannedPaise: number | null | undefined): number | null` returns `entered ?? plannedPaise ?? null`. The field shows the plan until the driver touches it, then his entry.
(b) `openingCashEntered(next: number | null): number` returns `next ?? 0`. Clear, ⌫ to empty and an emptied web field all mean ₹0, never the plan again (DOS-146).

The doc comment says that in screen state `null` means untouched: the plan is shown, nothing is sent, and depart keeps trips.opening_cash_paise. A number is what the driver entered, 0 included.

Red-first order:
1. Land the module and the spec with today's rule first: `openingCashEntered(next: number | null): number | null { return next }`. A `: number` return type would not typecheck with that identity body.
2. Run the spec and watch tests 1, 2, 4 and 5 fail.
3. Change the body to `next ?? 0`, tighten the return type to `number`, and wire the screen.

New vitest spec holding the five DOS-146 tests listed under tests.

(i) A `drive(planned, keys)` helper runs the controlled pad loop exactly as the native NumberPad (frontend/libs/ui/src/native/money.tsx:165-183) and the screen run it.
   - Mount: `entered = null`, `shown = openingCashShown(entered, planned)`, `entry = padEntryFromPaise(shown)`.
   - Each key: `current = reconcilePadEntry(entry, shown)`, then `entry = pressMoneyPadKey(current, key)`, then `entered = openingCashEntered(paiseFromPadEntry(entry))`, then `shown = openingCashShown(entered, planned)`.
   - It returns four things: the preview `formatPadEntry(reconcilePadEntry(entry, shown))`; the spoken label `speakMoney(paiseFromPadEntry(reconcilePadEntry(entry, shown)) ?? 0)`; the value the field holds after Done (`shown`); and what depart sends (`entered`, where null means the key is left out).
   - The pad helpers are imported from '@dos/ui' only, never '@dos/ui/web', which frontend/libs/config/eslint/app.js refuses. parity.test.ts:344-372 pins both renderers to these helpers.

(ii) The web case models RupeeInput's onChange and onBlur. `parseRupees('')` is `{ok:false, reason:'empty'}`, which calls onChange(null), and the text on blur is `toEditableRupees(openingCashShown(openingCashEntered(null), 300000))`.

(iii) The screen guard reads app/trip/start.tsx as text, the same way frontend/sales-app/src/order-entry-layout.test.ts:24-55 does:
   - non-literal 'node:fs' / 'node:url' specifiers, because @types/node is deliberately absent from an app (env.d.ts);
   - `fileURLToPath`, because the repo path has a space;
   - comments stripped before matching.

Fixtures are the dos_qa rows: sai-distributors TRIP-NEXT, 300000.

Import `openingCashEntered, openingCashShown` from '../../src/lib/opening-cash'.

Edits:
- Line 290 becomes `value={openingCashShown(cashPaise, detail?.openingCashPaise)}`.
- Line 291 becomes `onChange={(next) => { setCashPaise(openingCashEntered(next)) }}`.
- Line 347 (confirm body) becomes `cash: formatINR(paise(openingCashShown(cashPaise, detail?.openingCashPaise) ?? 0))`. The dialog then prints exactly the float that will be written (UX-00 §6.12), through the same rule as the field.
- Line 75 gets a one-line comment: null means untouched (the plan is kept), never 'emptied'.

Unchanged on purpose:
- The depart input builder (lines 125-133) keeps its `input.cashPaise === null` guard. It must stay a null check, never a falsy check, so that 0 is sent.
- onConfirm (lines 353-356) still passes `cashPaise` raw.

No useEffect seeding, and no strings, contract, permission, kit, offline or backend change.

contractChange: none. DepartTripInput.openingCashPaise (backend/libs/contracts/src/delivery.ts:735) already accepts any non-negative override, including 0, and trips.service.ts:388 already applies it with `??`.
architectDesignFollowed:
yes. The design is implemented as written: an emptied field is ₹0, and an untouched field still shows and keeps the planned float.

One structural addition: the rule lives in a tiny pure module (src/lib/opening-cash.ts) instead of inline in start.tsx, and a source-reading guard ties the screen to it. The reason is that the charter needs a failing test named DOS-146, and a screen under app/ cannot be imported in Node because it pulls in react-native and expo-router (sales-app/src/order-entry-layout.test.ts:11-13). This matches how DOS-061 extracted trip-choice.ts. Behaviour is identical to the one-line inline fix.

tests.name: DOS-146: on TRIP-NEXT planned with a ₹3,000 float, opening the pad, Clear, then 4 7 5 6 and Done holds ₹4,756 (475600 paise), not ₹3,00,04,756
DOS-146: Clear on the pre-filled ₹3,000 previews ₹0 ('0 rupees') and holds 0, and ⌫ eight times from ₹4,756 ends at ₹0 with Done leaving 0 to send, never the planned 300000 again
DOS-146 guard: an untouched field shows the planned 300000 and sends nothing (depart keeps trips.opening_cash_paise); a touched field keeps the driver's entry when the trip is re-read with the plan
DOS-146: an emptied web field (onChange(null)) holds 0, so blur formats it as 0.00 instead of snapping back to 3000.00

DOS-146: trip/start.tsx renders, edits and confirms 'Cash handed to you' through openingCashShown/openingCashEntered, with no `cashPaise ?? detail?.openingCashPaise` fallback left and depart still leaving out only a null float

Automated (in frontend/, after `export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; eval "$(fnm env)"; fnm use 24`):
1. Red. With opening-cash.ts on the identity rule and start.tsx not yet wired, `pnpm --filter @dos/delivery-app test` fails tests 1, 2, 4 and 5:
   - the preview after Clear + 4756 is '₹3,00,04,756';
   - the shown value after Clear is 300000;
   - the web blur text is '3000.00';
   - start.tsx still contains `cashPaise ?? detail?.openingCashPaise`.
   Test 3 passes, because it guards what must not change.
2. Green. All five pass, and trip-choice.test.ts stays green.
3. Run `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm format:check` for the frontend workspace.
4. If the delivery-app vitest cannot evaluate '@dos/ui' (no app test has imported it at runtime before), stop and report. Do not copy pad logic into the app, and do not import '@dos/ui/web'.

Android (Pixel_7_API_36 booted with -memory 3072; the platform where the finding was seen):

5. Tap Clear. Before the fix: ₹3,000. After: ₹0, with preview label '0 rupees'.

risk:
Low. The change is one screen, one pure helper and one spec. There is no kit, contract, backend, strings or dependency change.

Behaviour that changes:
- An emptied field is now ₹0 on every platform and is sent as openingCashPaise 0. The contract allows it, and check-in's expected cash then correctly uses a zero float.
- Clear then Done shows ₹0.00 on this screen. collect.tsx and expenses.tsx show '—' in that case, because they have no fallback.

Behaviour kept on purpose (a verifier re-running the finding will still see this):
- Digits typed straight onto the untouched pre-filled ₹3,000, without Clear first, still append. The finding's step 4 still reads ₹3,00,04,756.
- This is the DOS-060 rule for every reopened amount. It is documented at money.ts:120-124 and pinned by money.test.ts:157-171, and retailer Pay and any reopened collect/expenses amount share it.
- Making a first key replace a pre-fill would be a kit-wide change that rewrites DOS-060's pinned tests, and it is not in the architect's design.
- What this fix guarantees: the driver can reach any amount (Clear or ⌫, then type), and the pad preview plus the confirm body ('float ₹…') show the figure before anything is written.
- The finding's business-impact line ('taps one digit and starts the trip with a float in crores') is therefore mitigated by the confirm body, not removed.
- Closing the pad with Android back (onRequestClose), or Done with no key pressed, leaves cashPaise null, so the plan is kept. This is unchanged.

Test-run risk: this is the first app-level test that evaluates '@dos/ui' at runtime. Evidence that it works:
- The package's 'default' export is src/index.web.ts (frontend/libs/ui/package.json), which re-exports shared.ts and web/index.ts.
- Every module that web/index.ts re-exports is already evaluated in Node by frontend/libs/ui/src/web/render.test.tsx under the same config-less vitest.
- The kit tsconfig sets jsx 'react-jsx' (frontend/libs/config/tsconfig/react-library.json).
- react and react-dom are hoisted.
This was not proven by a run, because the review was read-only.
reviewNotes:
WHAT I CHANGED
1. Test claims. The original verify said all four DOS-146 tests fail before the fix. Test 3 (an untouched field shows and keeps the plan; a touched entry survives a re-read) passes on today's identity rule. It is a guard, and it is now named that way. Tests 1, 2 and 4 are the red ones.
2. Added test 5, a screen guard that reads app/trip/start.tsx as text (the sales-app/src/order-entry-layout.test.ts pattern). Without it, the helper spec proves the rule, but nothing fails if start.tsx keeps or regains `cashPaise ?? detail?.openingCashPaise`. The screen itself cannot be imported under vitest.
3. Red phase corrected. An identity `openingCashEntered` cannot carry the `: number` return type (typecheck fails), so the red body is typed `number | null` and tightened together with the fix.
4. Root-cause citations corrected:
   - web RupeeInput onChange is money.tsx:225-231 and onBlur is :232-237;
   - added the `[value, focused]` effect (:152-154), which re-applies the fallback when focus drops;
   - native Clear is :290-297.
   Added the checks that rule out a second cause: the server's `??` at trips.service.ts:388, no trigger on opening_cash_paise, depart is online-only, delivery is in TRIP_PLANNERS, and isLoading is first-load-only, so the refetch after startLoading keeps state.
5. Verification:
   - Added the finding's step 4 explicitly as NOT changed (append onto the pre-fill, DOS-060 rule), so the verifier does not read it as a failed fix.
   - Turned the control into a read-only dialog check. The original step 13 needed a second planned trip, and none exists for Sai once TRIP-NEXT departs (kalyan TRIP-NEXT has 0 stops).
   - Flagged that departing Sai TRIP-NEXT dispatches its 2 packed orders irreversibly on dos_qa.
   - Completed the iOS command (`ios-login.mjs <port> <user> <app> [Title]`).
   - Added the check that an untouched field returns to the plan after reopening.
   - Added `format:check`.
6. Risk now states that the finding's business-impact hazard of typing onto the pre-fill is mitigated by the preview and the confirm body, not removed.

KEPT (verified correct)
- The single root cause.
- The helper split (openingCashShown / openingCashEntered) and the three start.tsx edits.
- The semantics: untouched means null, and the key is left out of depart.
- No kit, contract or backend change.
- dependsOn []. No held plan and no batch-2 plan on disk touches start.tsx: held-review-brief.md mentions start.tsx only in the DOS-146 row, and the only batch-2 plan (DOS-115) is backend orders/permissions. DOS-056 edits delivery-app package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml, but this plan adds no dependency.
- The scope exclusion of retailer pay.tsx and manager inbound/documents.tsx:418.

COULD NOT CONFIRM (read-only review)
- That the delivery-app vitest actually evaluates '@dos/ui'. The indirect evidence is strong; see risk.
- Any device or browser behaviour. No walk was run.

RESIDUAL DOUBTS
- QA may treat the finding's step 4 (typing 4756 straight onto ₹3,000) as part of DOS-146. The architect's design covers only the emptied field. If QA or the founder wants a first key to replace a pre-filled amount, that is a separate kit slice in money.ts and both NumberPads, with its own id. It would rewrite DOS-060's pinned pad tests and change retailer Pay too.
- The native desk-density RN TextInput branch (native/money.tsx:333-335 resets the text on every value change) cannot be reached here, because the delivery app fixes density 'field' (src/config.ts:22).
- The same `x ?? fallback` class remains at retailer-app/app/pay.tsx:141 and manager-app/app/inbound/documents.tsx:418 (see notes).
notes:
Scope. retailer-app/app/pay.tsx:141-142 (`value={amount ?? owed}` / `onChange={setAmount}`) has the same defect. It is deliberately NOT fixed here, even though the finding's suggested fix names it:
(1) The architect's design covers only trip/start.tsx, and the charter forbids adjacent fixes.
(2) It was never walked and has no finding id.
(3) `?? 0` is the wrong fix there. An emptied Pay amount of 0 would disable Start with the wrong reason (pay.tsx:104-109, `t('r3.noBills')`), and the helper text 'Leave it as it is to pay everything you owe' (retailer strings.ts:191) has to change with it.
It also shares that line with DOS-154 and the flow with DOS-124. Recommendation: log it as its own finding and fix it together with DOS-124 and DOS-154 as one Pay-screen slice.

manager-app/app/inbound/documents.tsx:418 `value={totalPaise ?? header.totalPaise}` (a desk web text field; clearing it snaps back on blur) is the same class. Log it separately if QA confirms it. Every other RupeeInput call site found by git grep over frontend/*-app/app uses plain state.

UX-00 §6.3 says cash COLLECTION shows the expected amount above the pad and never pre-fills it [UX-01 D6]. The float is not a collection. The pre-filled plan on this screen predates the finding, and the architect's design keeps it.

Batch-2 neighbours:
- DOS-164 (kit modal host) may change when the NumberPad mounts. This fix does not depend on it, because the pad reconciles with the screen's value on every render.
- DOS-150 (the emptied field's accessibility label) is a kit issue. An emptied float is now 0 and reads '0 rupees', so this screen no longer reaches DOS-150.
- DOS-152 (W5 short sheet) is warehouse-only.
- DOS-131+137 (plan a trip, with a float field in another app) should keep plain state and must not copy the `x ?? fallback` value pattern.

After merge, add a build-log / QA/13-change-log.md row for DOS-146.
